source: Yahoo Finance EURUSD=X 5-minute OHLC chart history, 60-day request

inference.multiple_testing: Benjamini-Hochberg across the frozen candidate set

verdict_rule: Candidate survives only if at least 200 OOS trades, 95% block-bootstrap lower bound of mean net return per bar above zero at 0.2 pip, and BH-corrected test rejected. No-trade is the control.
scientific_boundary: Post-cutoff historical evaluation, not live evidence or a broker-cost/profitability claim.
